title: Noivern ex - 153/193 - Pokemon Paldea Evolved Ultra Rare Card NM English
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
This Noivern ex card is a must-have for any serious Pokemon TCG collector. With its ultra rare status and Paldea Evolved designation, it's a valuable addition to any collection. The card features the popular Noivern ex character and has a card number of 153/193.
The card is in excellent shape, with no noticeable flaws or defects. It's in standard size and in English language, making it accessible to a wide audience. The card is manufactured by Nintendo and is suitable for ages 4 and up. Don't miss out on the chance to add this specialty card to your collection!
